headline: Park renovation quote and a review of 13 strategic plan objectives.
summary: Maggie will present a shortened list of 13 objectives from the current strategic plan. Residents will see whether the group plans to keep them, revise them, or drop them. An updated park renovation quote is also up for discussion.
items: Library director's report, including building repairs, statistics, and a park renovation quote
plain_text:
HOLYOKE PUBLIC LIBRARY BOARD MEETING
November 10, 2026, 5:30PM
CALL TO ORDER ESTIMATED TIME 5 minutes
Roll Call
Approve Minutes
ANNOUNCEMENTS NOT COVERVERED IN REPORTS
PRESIDENT ESTIMATED TIME 15 minutes
LIBRARY DIRECTOR'S REPORT Estimated Time 20 minutes
Announcements
I received permission from George to close at noon Friday, December 11 th for a staff holiday
potluck gathering.
Building Updates
On Monday 11/2 George and I met with TJ Plante, the city's new CAFO, last week about the
city paying for repairs to both our fire suppression systems and also our elevator. We also
followed up on a conversation George had with the mayor about covering the cost of some
painting in the building.
The city officially replaced and paid for the window that was damaged by weed whacking in
June.
Staff Updates
For the first time in a long time, there are none to note
Statistics
Excel document emailed
Requests
An updated park renovation quote is attached. A discussion about moving forward would be
appreciated.
Next meeting date 12/15/26
FINANCE REPORT Estimated Time 20 minutes
COMMITTEE REPORTS Estimated Time 20 minutes
Strategic planning
Maggie is presenting an abridged list of 13 objectives from the current strategic plan to the
board, to determine if we should continue trying to meet them, revise them, or drop them.
